battle.name: 大同盟戰爭
battle.theater: 萊茵河中游普法爾茨戰線
battle.brief: 一六八八年路易十四渡萊茵、席捲普法爾茨，威廉乘亂登陸英格蘭，九年戰爭自此沿萊茵下游與佛蘭德斯展開。真正左右會戰節奏的是野砲：它能拆成數輛馬車牽引，隨軍轉進，在弗勒於與拉登以逐次齊射壓住敵陣，圍城與野戰也從此共用同一門砲。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 一六八八年起，歐洲分成兩個對壘的集團。法國一方以凡爾賽的御前會議為最高軍事機關，路易十四自居「戰爭之王」，戰略由他與軍事大臣盧瓦、外交總管龐查特蘭共同定奪；陸軍以王家軍團為骨幹，分為近衛法蘭西騎兵、王家近衛步兵與各堡民兵，線列步兵按團與營編制，龍騎兵團自一六七〇年代起陸續成立，另有外籍與土耳其騎兵，炮兵與攻城工程兵由瓦邦統轄。一六八八年法軍名額約三十萬，一六九三年增至近四十萬，是當時歐洲規模空前的常備軍。對面的大同盟分兩步組成：一六八八年帝國、荷蘭、西班牙、瑞典先立奧格斯堡聯盟；一六八九年五月一日荷蘭、帝國與英格蘭在海牙訂立三國條約，正式結成大同盟，一六九四年西班牙再以四方同盟的形式加入。聯盟陸軍由各國分攤：帝國軍為各選帝侯與諸邦的佣兵，名義上歸皇帝統率，實戰多由普法爾茨、薩克森、巴伐利亞與洛林的將領分段指揮；荷蘭軍隊是聯盟骨幹，總司令常由奧蘭治的威廉兼任；英格蘭以威廉三世為國王、輝格黨掌政，透過議會撥款維持一支規模不大的分遣隊，並以補貼養活帝國軍；西班牙在卡洛斯二世治下出兵有限，只提供西屬尼德蘭守軍與美洲銀流。聯盟的弱點從頭到尾都是沒有總指揮：每次出動都要靠各國代表議會式協調，英格蘭與荷蘭在商業利益上互相牽制，聯盟也屢次在死守防線還是反攻、如何處置法國在萊茵的殘餘佔地上分裂。一六八九年後奧斯曼帝國在匈牙利前線吸走奧地利的大量兵力，聯盟的資源因此更加分散。
countriesEn: From 1688 Europe split into two opposed blocs. On the French side the royal war council at Versailles was the highest military authority; Louis XIV styled himself the war king and settled strategy together with the war minister Louvois and the controller of the household Pontchartrain. The army was built on the king's own regiments: the gardes du corps, the household foot and the garrison militias, line infantry organised in regiments and battalions, dragoon regiments raised one after another from the 1670s, and foreign and Turkish cavalry, with the artillery and the siege engineers under Vauban. The French establishment stood at about 300,000 men in 1688 and had swollen to nearly 400,000 by 1693, an unprecedented peacetime army for Europe. On the other side the Grand Alliance was put together in two steps: in 1688 the Empire, Holland, Spain and Sweden first formed the League of Augsburg; on 1 May 1689 Holland, the Empire and England concluded the triple treaty at The Hague that created the Grand Alliance; and in 1694 Spain rejoined as a quadruple alliance. The allied land forces were apportioned among the members. The Imperial army consisted of the contingents of the electors and the smaller states, nominally under the Emperor but in practice commanded in sections by the Palatine, Saxon, Bavarian and Lorrain generals; the Dutch army was the backbone of the alliance and the captain-generalcy was usually held by William of Orange; England, ruled by William III with the Whigs in power, voted money in parliament to keep a small detachment in the field and to pay the enormous subsidies that kept the Imperial army alive; Spain under Charles II contributed little manpower but supplied the garrison of the Spanish Netherlands and the silver of the Americas. The weakness of the alliance lay throughout in the absence of a single commander: every operation had to be coordinated in parliamentary fashion among national representatives, England and Holland held each other back over commercial interest, and the allies divided again and again over whether to hold the lines on the defensive or to counter-attack, and over how to deal with France's remaining footholds on the Rhine. After 1689 the Ottoman presence on the Hungarian front drew away a large part of Austria's strength, and the resources of the coalition were scattered still further.
people: 左右戰局的是十幾個人。路易十四自一六八八年秋起把萊茵戰役交給蒙莫雷西公爵盧森堡，這位元帥是法國在低地最傑出的指揮官，弗勒於、斯滕凱爾克、拉登三戰均由他取勝，卻因舊傷與操勞在一六九五年初病逝；接替他的是蒂費里侯爵，與維勒魯瓦公爵、瓦邦侯爵、卡蒂納、諾阿耶同屬法國的統帥層：瓦邦主持攻城與築城，卡蒂納在納穆爾與威廉三世談判守軍投降，維勒魯瓦在一六九三年拉登被包圍時被俘，至一六九五年才由英格蘭設法贖回。聯盟方面，奧蘭治的威廉三世是唯一貫串全戰的指揮者，一六九〇年博因河、低地各役、一六九二年親自督造納穆爾的圍城工事，都是他的手筆；荷蘭執政官海因修斯是聯盟真正的策士，堅持聯盟不與法國單獨媾和。帝國與西班牙的將領中，普法爾茨選侯查理二世與其弟威廉五世本身就是衝突的源頭，薩克森選侯約翰·喬治三世與巴伐利亞選侯麥西米利安二世先後統兵，洛林的弗朗茨·卡爾與帝國元帥梅爾西伯爵在萊茵作戰，一六八八年七月十三日梅爾西在沃爾夫斯基興戰役中陣亡。英格蘭方面，輝格黨人哈利法克斯與索爾茲伯里支持威廉入主；愛爾蘭戰線上，詹姆士二世與法國派來的拉胡斯伯爵、聖魯斯侯爵對上威廉的將軍，帕特里克·薩斯菲爾德以利默里克守軍拖住聯軍。技術骨幹則是炮兵與工程兵：法軍一側由瓦邦主持，聯軍一側則由荷蘭工程師科霍恩一手包辦防禦工事。海軍方面，法國的特魯維爾率主力迎擊英荷聯合分隊，英國的霍普與魯克各守一方。
peopleEn: A dozen-odd men really decided how this war went. From the autumn of 1688 Louis XIV entrusted the Rhine campaign to the duc de Luxembourg, Montmorency-Bouteville, the ablest French commander in the Low Countries, who won at Fleurus, Steenkerque and Landen but died of his old wounds and overwork in the early months of 1695; the marquis de Tilly took over, and around him stood the duc de Villeroy, the marquis de Vauban, Catinat and Noailles. Vauban directed the sieges and the fortification work, Catinat negotiated the capitulation of Namur with William III, and Villeroy was taken prisoner when he was encircled at Landen in 1693, not being ransomed until 1695. On the allied side William of Orange was the one commander who ran through the whole war: the Boyne in 1690, the campaigns in the Low Countries, and the siege works he personally drove at Namur in 1692 were all his; Grand Pensionary Anthonie Heinsius was the real strategist of the alliance and insisted that it not make a separate peace with France. Among the Imperial and Spanish commanders, the Elector Palatine Charles II and his brother William V were themselves the source of the quarrel, the Elector of Saxony Johann Georg III and the Elector of Bavaria Maximilian II Emanuel led troops in turn, and the duke of Lorraine Franz Karl and the Imperial marshal Count Mercy fought on the Rhine, Mercy being killed at the battle of Wolfskirche on 13 July 1688. In England the Whigs Halifax and Shrewsbury backed William's accession; on the Irish front James II and the French envoys the Count of Lauzun and the Marquis de St Ruth faced William's generals, while Patrick Sarsfield held the besieged garrison of Limerick. The technical backbone was the artillery and the engineers: on the French side Vauban, and on the allied side the Dutch engineer Coehoorn, who directed the defensive works with his own hand. At sea the French admiral Tourville brought his main fleet against the combined Anglo-Dutch squadrons, with Hopton and Rooke each guarding his own station.
kits: 這場戰爭的兵器主軸是野砲。所謂野砲，指十六世紀中期開始出現的輕型可移動火炮：管身短、重量小，可以拆成炮身、炮車、裝彈藥與點火桿的前車，以及備件與藥箱車數輛，由馬隊分拖，不需依賴城堡或圍城器械，因而能在野戰中隨軍前進。它的血統在十七世紀末延續成野戰炮：法國野砲線以四磅、六磅、八磅與十二磅為主，另有十二磅與二十四磅的支援砲；荷蘭與帝國軍同樣以八磅與十二磅為骨幹，並配四磅輕砲。整套重量四磅砲約九百公斤、須六匹馬拖曳，八磅砲約一噸出頭、須八匹馬，十二磅砲接近一點二噸、須九至十匹馬，每門砲配六至八名炮手、點火桿手與馬夫。射擊程序是裝填手把定量火藥塞入藥窪，再壓入定量的鐵彈或球形彈，以引線或火繩點燃；十七世紀的野砲多已改用燧石發火，即所謂的燧發砲，射程視口徑與裝藥而定，八磅砲有效射程大約在一千至一千五百步之間，十二磅砲稍遠。野砲在戰術上的位置有三：一是在會戰前沿排成砲兵線，以整營或整排齊射而不是逐門零星發射，一次齊射的份量往往足以在幾百步內撕開對方步兵的縱列；二是在追擊、封鎖道路、掩護渡河、警戒宿營與隨軍傳令時提供機動火力；三是在野戰轉圍城、或圍城轉野戰時能隨部隊轉進而不必更換器械。與野砲並存的，還有線列步兵的火繩槍與燧發槍——法國步兵已統一到米凱萊式燧發槍，英格蘭陸軍用「棕貝絲」燧發長槍，荷蘭步兵用荷蘭式燧發槍，帝國軍在一六九〇年代末才逐步換裝；近戰靠插在槍管下的筒式刺刀。攻城方面是另一套器械：重攻城砲、臼炮、轟擊砲，以及平行壕溝、盲壕射擊孔、地雷與可拆式攻城橋，由工程兵操作。騎兵有法國近衛騎兵與龍騎兵、荷蘭與帝國的胸甲騎兵、驃騎與土耳其輕騎；馬匹靠本地徵集並從愛爾蘭、漢諾威與匈牙利輸入，彈藥與糧食靠牛車、大篷車隊與萊茵、荷蘭運河上的河船，渡河則用可拆式浮橋。
kitsEn: The spine of this war's armament was the field gun. By field gun one means the light mobile artillery that first appeared in the middle of the sixteenth century: a short tube of modest weight, divisible into the gun itself, its carriage, a limber wagon carrying the ammunition and the linstock, and further wagons for spare parts and charges, all towed in separate teams by horses. It needed no castle or siege establishment and could therefore move with the army in the field. By the end of the seventeenth century that lineage had become the field battery: on the French side the line ran on four-, six-, eight- and twelve-pounder pieces with twelve- and twenty-four-pounder support guns, while the Dutch and Imperial armies used eight- and twelve-pounders as their backbone with light four-pounders to accompany them. A four-pounder with its limber weighed about nine hundred kilograms and needed six horses, an eight-pounder a little over a ton and eight horses, a twelve-pounder close to one and a quarter tons and nine or ten horses, and each gun carried six to eight gunners, linstock men and drivers. The drill was that the loader rammed a measured charge into the hollow of the breech, the gunner followed it with a measured iron or round shot, and the piece was fired by fuse or match; by the seventeenth century most field guns were struck by flint, that is, they were flintlock pieces, and their range depended on calibre and charge, an eight-pounder reaching perhaps a thousand to fifteen hundred paces of effective range and the twelve-pounder a little further. The field gun held three tactical positions. First, it stood in a line of artillery in front of the infantry and fired in batteries or by rank rather than gun by gun, a single salvo being enough to tear open an enemy column at a few hundred paces. Second, it supplied the mobile fire used in pursuit, in blocking roads, in covering a river crossing, in watching the quarters at night and in escorting dispatches. Third, it could be moved across the whole course of a campaign without the piece being changed, whether the fighting turned from open field to siege or from siege back to open field. Alongside it stood the matchlock and flintlock of the line infantry: the French foot had already been standardised on the miquelet flintlock, the English army used the flintlock long gun known as the Brown Bess, the Dutch carried the Holland flintlock, and the Imperial troops only began to convert in the late 1690s; close combat rested on socket bayonets pushed into the barrel. Siege work used a different set of tools entirely: heavy siege guns, mortars and ricochet batteries, together with the parallel trench, blind saps, mines and dismantlable assault bridges, handled by the engineers. The cavalry included the French gardes and dragoons, the cuirassiers, dragoons and light Turkish riders of Holland and the Empire; horses were levied locally and brought in from Ireland, Hanover and Hungary, while ammunition and food travelled in ox carts, heavy wagon trains and river craft on the Rhine and the Dutch canals, with dismantlable pontoon bridges for crossings.
tactics: 作戰形態上，這場戰爭是法國的集中打點對聯盟的分線消耗。一六八八年秋法軍在萊茵上架浮橋渡河，先以縱隊插入普法爾茨，再把帝國軍與西班牙軍分割，聯盟的第一場會戰在沃爾夫斯基興以梅爾西陣亡告終。一六八九年春法軍在普法爾茨實施焦土：燒掉城鎮與倉儲、拆毀橋樑，企圖切斷聯軍的駐紮、徵糧與冬營，迫使聯軍退入荷蘭境內防守。法國此後轉以圍城為主，瓦邦改進的攻法是平行壕溝配合盲壕射擊孔、以臼炮壓制城頭，最後以坑道爆破收尾；荷蘭與帝國的防禦則依賴城市要塞與野外防線，一六九二年法軍攻破林堡與斯滕凱爾克外圍的野戰防線，一六九三年聯軍放棄斯海爾德防線，法軍隨即將其拆毀，一六九七年再以塹壕重建。會戰上聯軍偏愛橫線與縱深配置，法軍屢用分縱隊迂迴聯軍翼側：一六九二年八月三日斯滕凱爾克，法軍以萬代恩貝克式的迂迴插入英荷聯軍右翼，並把野砲集中到奪得的埃斯科高地射擊，四萬餘人的聯軍被二萬餘人的法軍擊潰；一六九三年七月二十九日拉登，法軍再切聯軍左翼，同樣以野砲先奪高地，聯軍陣亡受傷約八千人、被俘約一萬四千人，維勒魯瓦也在此役被俘。英格蘭與愛爾蘭戰線的樣式不同：一六九〇年七月一日博因河，威廉的聯軍以步兵在泥濘灘頭強渡、兩翼騎兵迂迴，詹姆士二世的軍隊陣亡、被俘與溺斃者甚眾；一六九一年奧赫里姆，愛爾蘭聯軍的蘇格蘭與愛爾蘭騎兵以反擊扭轉戰局；一六九〇至九一年利默里克圍城，薩斯菲爾德在聯軍攻城時夜襲缺口守軍，迫使英軍放棄攻城。海軍方面，英荷聯合艦隊以分隊巡航封鎖英吉利海峽與荷蘭沿岸的航路，一六九〇年比奇角與一六九三年特克塞爾兩役，法軍以縱列與近岸限制英荷分隊接戰。封鎖與冬季徵糧同樣是戰爭的一部分：聯軍靠荷蘭運河與城鎮倉庫維持，法軍靠口糧車隊與就地徵收，冬夏營之間的轉場節奏決定了法軍能連續作戰多久。
tacticsEn: In operational form this war was French concentration set against allied dispersal. In the autumn of 1688 the French bridged the Rhine, drove their columns into the Palatinate and cut the Imperial and Spanish armies apart, and the coalition's first pitched battle ended at Wolfskirche with the death of Mercy. In the spring of 1689 the French carried out a scorched-earth campaign in the Palatinate: burning the towns and the magazines and breaking down the bridges in order to cut the allies' billeting, foraging and winter quarters, and to force them back inside the Dutch frontier. France then turned to siege warfare, and Vauban's improved method was the parallel trench combined with blind saps, mortars used to silence the parapet and a mine to end the business; the Dutch and Imperial defence relied on fortresses and on lines in the field. In 1692 the French broke the field lines outside Huy and Steenkerque; in 1693 the allies abandoned the Scheldt lines and the French razed them, only to rebuild them in 1697 with entrenchments. In battle the allies preferred the extended line and depth, and the French repeatedly turned their wing with columns: at Steenkerque on 3 August 1692 the French forced the pass with a Vandenbergh-style turning movement into the right of the Anglo-Dutch army and concentrated their field guns on the heights of Esquelbec taken by the vanguard, and more than forty thousand allies were beaten by some twenty-three thousand French; at Landen on 29 July 1693 the French cut the allied left again, the field guns again taking the heights first, the allies losing about eight thousand killed and wounded and some fourteen thousand prisoners, Villeroy among them. The English and Irish theatre worked differently: at the Boyne on 1 July 1690 William's army forced the boggy crossings with the infantry and turned the position with cavalry on both wings, and James II's army lost heavily in killed, captured and drowned; at Aughrim in 1691 the Scottish and Irish cavalry of the Williamite army turned the battle with a counter-attack; and in the siege of Limerick in 1690 and 1691 Sarsfield struck the assaulting troops at the breach by night and forced the English to abandon the siege. At sea the combined Anglo-Dutch squadrons sought to close the sea lanes in the Channel and off the Dutch coast by cruising in separate divisions, and at Beachy Head in 1690 and the Texel in 1693 the French used their line ahead and their position close inshore to prevent the Anglo-Dutch squadrons from closing. Blockade and winter foraging were as much a part of this war as the fighting: the allies drew on the Dutch canals and the magazines of the towns, the French on their bread convoys and on requisitioning in place, and the rhythm of moving between winter and summer quarters decided how long the French could keep the war going.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一六八八年十一月的「光榮革命」算起，至一六九七年九月二十日《萊士維克和約》簽訂，前後九年；一六九五年十一月十三日法西《比利牛斯條約》與一六九六至九七年英荷對法秘密和談，使聯盟在正式停火前已名存實亡。兵力方面，法國陸軍名額一六八八年約三十萬，一六九三年增至近四十萬；一六八八年渡萊茵的遠征軍被記作約十四萬至十六萬人之間，諸說不一。聯軍總兵力峰值約二十萬至三十萬人，其中帝國軍約十萬、荷蘭軍約六萬、英格蘭分遣隊與受補貼維持的軍隊約二萬至三萬。會戰方面：弗勒於（一六九〇年六月二十一日）法軍約二萬四千人對聯軍約二萬二千人，法軍勝；斯滕凱爾克（一六九二年八月三日）法軍約二萬三千人對聯軍約四萬五千人；拉登（一六九三年七月二十九日）法軍約二萬五千人對聯軍約五萬五千人，聯軍陣亡受傷約八千人、被俘約一萬四千人。博因河（一六九〇年七月一日）威廉一方約二萬二千人對詹姆士二世約二萬二千人，後者陣亡與被俘約二千人。納穆爾圍城（一六九二年）聯軍投入約六萬人，法軍守備約六千人，自五月下旬開工到六月二十四日突擊奪城、七月五日以坑道炸開堡壘，前後約兩個月。野砲的規格數字也大致可比：四磅砲連前車約九百公斤、須六匹馬，八磅砲約一噸出頭、須八匹馬，十二磅砲接近一點二噸、須九至十匹馬，每砲炮手六至八人。普法爾茨在一六八九、一六九三、一六九四三度被焚，曼海姆、海德堡、施佩耶等數十座城鎮受創，海德堡於一六九三年被毀。財政上，法國軍費在頭三年急增，和約簽訂後法軍立即裁軍，名額縮減近半，約由四十萬降至十五萬至二十萬之間。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war is counted from the Glorious Revolution of November 1688 to the signature of the Treaty of Ryswick on 20 September 1697, a matter of nine years; the Franco-Spanish Treaty of the Pyrenees of 13 November 1695 and the secret English and Dutch understandings with France of 1696 and 1697 left the alliance hollow long before the formal armistice. In men: the French establishment was about 300,000 in 1688 and had grown to nearly 400,000 by 1693, and the army that crossed the Rhine in 1688 is set down at somewhere between 140,000 and 160,000, the figures differing from one account to the next. The coalition's total strength at its peak was about 200,000 to 300,000, of which the Imperial army was roughly 100,000, the Dutch about 60,000 and the English detachments and the troops kept alive by subsidy some 20,000 to 30,000. At the level of battles: Fleurus on 21 June 1690, about 24,000 French against some 22,000 allies, a French victory; Steenkerque on 3 August 1692, about 23,000 French against some 45,000 allies; Landen on 29 July 1693, about 25,000 French against some 55,000 allies, the allies losing about 8,000 killed and wounded and 14,000 prisoners. At the Boyne on 1 July 1690 William had about 22,000 against about 22,000 for James II, the Jacobites losing some 2,000 in killed and captured. In the siege of Namur in 1692 the allies brought in about 60,000 men against a French garrison of roughly 6,000; work began in late May, the town fell by assault on 24 June and the citadel was blown up by a mine on 5 July, the whole business taking about two months. The specifications of the field gun can be compared in much the same way: a four-pounder with its limber about nine hundred kilograms and six horses, an eight-pounder a little over a ton and eight horses, a twelve-pounder close to one and a quarter tons and nine or ten horses, with six to eight men to a gun. In the Palatinate the towns were burned in 1689, 1693 and 1694, Mannheim, Heidelberg, Speyer and several dozen other places were damaged, and Heidelberg was destroyed in 1693. On finance: French military expenditure rose steeply within the first three years of the war, and after the peace France at once cut the army, reducing the establishment by nearly half, from about 400,000 to somewhere between 150,000 and 200,000.
cause: 打起來的根子有三層。最外層是法國在歐洲的擴張打破了「權力均衡」：一六八一年法軍佔領斯特拉斯堡，一六八六年吞併科隆選侯國，一六八七年法國海軍遠征阿爾及爾，新關稅打擊荷蘭與英國的商業，巴黎又用敕令試圖把法國法律強加給外國商人，一六七九年《聖日耳曼條約》奠定的萊茵「喘息權」在歐洲看來正被逐年蠶食。宗教層面，路易十四在一六八五年撤銷《南特赦令》，大批胡格諾派被迫出走英格蘭、荷蘭與德意志諸邦，英國議會從此把法國的宗教政策視為對英格蘭的間接挑戰，荷蘭的流亡社群與英國的輝格黨因此落在同一條戰線上。最後是王朝與選帝位的問題：普法爾茨選侯查理二世在法國卵翼下當選，其弟威廉五世隨後繼承，帝國因此一分為二；巴伐利亞選侯麥西米利安二世在法國支持下於一六八八年再度爭取選帝位。結構性的導火線是一六八八年的「光榮革命」：英格蘭議會與奧蘭治家族達成默契，十一月威廉率艦隊渡海登陸，詹姆士二世出逃，一六八九年二月威廉與其妻瑪麗共同即位，荷蘭的軍力與英格蘭的議會財政從此合流。技術與制度層面上還有兩點替法國加了分：一是常備軍與嚴整的後勤制度讓火炮可以隨意出現在前線，二是可移動的野砲使法軍不必依賴攻城器械就能壓制野外部隊。與大同盟重疊的還有一六八三年起的大土耳其戰爭，奧地利在匈牙利對奧斯曼作戰，無法同時在西線壓上，聯盟從一開始就先天不足。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the outbreak. The outermost was French expansion in Europe and the breaking of the balance of power: the French took Strasbourg in 1681, swallowed the Electorate of Cologne in 1686, sent a fleet to Algiers in 1687, and the new customs duties struck at Dutch and English commerce while Paris pressed French law on foreign merchants with its own edicts, so that the Rhine breathing space of the Treaty of Saint-Germain of 1679 seemed to be eaten away year by year. The second layer was religious: Louis XIV revoked the Edict of Nantes in 1685 and a mass of Huguenots was driven out of France into England, Holland and the German states; the English parliament from then on treated French religious policy as an indirect attack upon England, and the Dutch refugee communities and the English Whigs found themselves on the same line. The last was dynastic and electoral: the Elector Palatine Charles II was elected under French protection and his brother William V succeeded him, which split the Empire in two, while the Elector of Bavaria Maximilian II Emanuel sought the imperial election once more in 1688 with French support. The structural trigger was the Glorious Revolution of 1688: the English parliament and the House of Orange came to an understanding, in November William crossed the sea with his fleet and landed, James II fled, and in February 1689 William and his wife Mary were crowned together, so that Dutch manpower and English parliamentary money flowed into the same war. On the technical and institutional side two further things told for France: a standing army and a tight logistics system allowed guns to appear at the front whenever they were wanted, and the mobile field gun allowed the French to crush an enemy deployed in the open without any siege establishment at all. Overlapping the Grand Alliance was the Great Turkish War, which began in 1683: Austria was fighting the Ottomans in Hungary and could not press on the western front at the same time, and the alliance was short of resources from the very first day.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果是法國的戰術勝利與聯盟的戰略失敗。第一，聯盟在戰後即告瓦解：荷蘭與英格蘭在一六九六至九七年已各自與法國達成秘密協議，《萊士維克和約》之後聯盟再無力重建，七年後法國重新開戰時面對的已是一支分崩離析的聯軍；荷蘭的商業優勢在戰後明顯被英國取代，英國海軍在戰爭中屢遭挫敗，卻靠議會撥款所建立的長期信用立起了海上霸權的雛形。第二，萊茵的格局被重寫：法國保住了斯特拉斯堡及其在阿爾薩斯的前哨，其餘新佔據點多數歸還；一六九七年的萊士維克宣言給了普法爾茨選侯一筆一次性的賠償並附有法國在萊茵的長期中立承諾，但選侯本人一六九五年才返回海德堡，重建的選侯國政府流亡在亞琛與紐倫堡，帝國西部的分裂並未解決，反而成為日後西班牙王位繼承戰爭的前奏。第三，技術與制度的後果更長久：瓦邦的圍城術在此戰中定型，聯盟各國的工程技術差距暴露無遺，歐洲此後加速由火繩槍轉向燧發槍，野砲也從「可拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲」正式定型為野戰炮兵，炮兵由輔助兵種升格為能單獨決定會戰與圍城的獨立兵種；聯盟的失敗讓法國確立了歐洲陸軍與財政的長期優勢，直到一七一三年才被重新組合的聯盟抵銷。第四，普法爾茨的浩劫成為一段長尾：被迫遷徙的德語人群後來出現在大西洋彼岸，賓夕法尼亞與新英格蘭一帶的德語移民社群，許多家系都來自這段普法爾茨流亡。第五，戰爭中的宣傳與輿論戰開了近代先例：法國用報紙、傳教士與年金在歐洲塑造形象，英國輝格黨用議會報告與海上封鎖製造輿論，戰爭第一次同時在戰場與報紙上進行。
impactEn: The result was a tactical victory for France and a strategic defeat for the alliance. First, the alliance fell apart as soon as the war was over: England and Holland had each come to secret terms with France in 1696 and 1697, and after Ryswick there was no force left to rebuild the coalition, so that when France went to war again seven years later it faced a league already coming apart; the commercial advantage of the Dutch was visibly replaced by the English, and though the Royal Navy was often beaten in the fighting, the long-term credit built on parliamentary funding laid the first stones of a maritime supremacy. Second, the map of the Rhine was rewritten: France kept Strasbourg and its outposts in Alsace and returned most of its new conquests; the Declaration of Ryswick in 1697 gave the Elector Palatine a one-off indemnity and a French neutrality promise on the Rhine, but the elector himself only returned to Heidelberg in 1695, his reconstructed government was exiled at Aachen and Nuremberg, and the division of the western Empire was not settled, becoming instead the prelude to the War of the Spanish Succession. Third, the institutional and technical consequences were longer lived: Vauban's siegecraft was stereotyped in this war, the gap in engineering between the allied powers was laid bare, Europe turned faster from the matchlock to the flintlock, and the field gun, which had begun as a piece that came apart into so many horse-drawn wagons, was now definitively a field arm, with the artillery promoted from a supporting arm to an independent one able to decide battles and sieges by itself; the alliance's failure confirmed France's long advantage in European armies and in finance, which was not cancelled until the coalition was reconstituted in 1713. Fourth, the ruin of the Palatinate had a long tail: the displaced German-speaking people appear later on the far side of the Atlantic, and many families in the German-speaking settlements of Pennsylvania and New England came from that Palatine exile. Fifth, propaganda and the war of opinion opened a modern precedent: France shaped its image in Europe with newspapers, missionaries and pensions, the English Whigs manufactured opinion with parliamentary reports and blockade, and for the first time the war was fought on the battlefield and in the press at once.
result: 結果是《萊士維克和約》：奧蘭治的威廉、皇帝利奧波德一世與西班牙的卡洛斯二世為一方，路易十四為另一方，於一六九七年九月二十日簽訂，同年十一月三十日批准。荷蘭保住了本土，屏障要塞雖未取回，卻換來法國對荷蘭獨立的承認與商業上的讓步；西班牙在與法國單獨和談後退出聯盟，等於在關鍵時刻抽走了聯盟的一條腿；帝國拿回法國在萊茵的多數新佔據點，卻沒能拿回斯特拉斯堡，也沒能讓普法爾茨選侯回到海德堡重建家園；英格蘭確認了威廉的國王地位，並在歐洲大陸的政策上換來法國的容忍，而荷蘭正是在這一輪之後把商業競爭的陣地慢慢讓了出來。兵器層面上，野砲在這場九年戰爭裡完成了最重要的角色轉換：它不再只是把堡壘拆開的工具，而是成為可以隨部隊轉進、直接左右會戰的火力單位。弗勒於、斯滕凱爾克、拉登三場翻盤，都不是靠鎗騎對決，而是靠野砲先奪高地、再由縱隊傾瀉；與此同時，與野砲同源的重攻城砲與臼炮把圍城術推到頂點，從此歐洲的戰爭被分成「野戰」與「圍城」兩套互相銜接的器械體系。九年之後，野砲留在每一支歐洲陸軍的編制表上，並在十八世紀隨著統一炮重與統一炮彈規格的推行，成為常備軍中最標準化的一個兵種。
resultEn: The outcome was the Treaty of Ryswick: William of Orange, the Emperor Leopold I and Charles II of Spain on one side, Louis XIV on the other, signed on 20 September 1697 and ratified on 30 November of the same year. Holland kept its homeland; the barrier fortresses were not recovered, but the Dutch obtained French recognition of their independence and commercial concessions; Spain, having made a separate peace with France, left the alliance and so pulled one of its legs out from under the coalition at the decisive moment; the Empire recovered most of France's new footholds on the Rhine but not Strasbourg, and the Elector Palatine was not brought home to Heidelberg to rebuild; England confirmed William's kingship and bought French toleration for its continental policy, while it was around this turn of the war that the Dutch began to give up the field of commercial rivalry. At the level of weapons, the field gun played out the most important change of its life in this nine-year war: it was no longer only the tool for pulling a fortress apart, but had become a unit of fire that could be moved with the column and decide a battle on the spot. The turnabouts at Fleurus, Steenkerque and Landen were not won by the duel of pike and shot but by the field guns taking the heights first and the columns pouring through behind them; at the same time the heavy siege guns and mortars that shared the field gun's lineage pushed the art of the siege to its height, and the war in Europe was henceforward split into two interlocking sets of equipment, one for open field and one for siege. Nine years later the field gun remained on the establishment of every European army, and in the eighteenth century, as the standard weight of the piece and the standard dimensions of its shot were made uniform, it became the most standardised arm in the standing armies of Europe.
